# PhotonDispatch

> Independent, answer-first quantum computing and quantum technology news: hardware, algorithms, industry and funding, research and policy.

## Articles
- [IQM says Emerald entangled all 54 qubits, with a GHZ fidelity of 0.516](https://photondispatch.com/news/iqm-emerald-54-qubit-ghz-fidelity.html): IQM says its Emerald cloud system prepared a 54-qubit GHZ state at fidelity 0.516 with readout-error mitigation, just above 0.5.
- [NIST says quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms are deprecated after 2030 and disallowed after 2035](https://photondispatch.com/news/nist-ir-8547-public-key-2030-2035.html): According to NIST IR 8547, published 27 October 2026, quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms are deprecated after 2030 and disallowed after 2035.
- [Iceberg Quantum cuts its RSA-2048 factoring estimate to about 48,000 qubits in simulations](https://photondispatch.com/news/iceberg-quantum-pinnacle-1-2-rsa-2048-estimate.html): Iceberg Quantum's Pinnacle 1.2 says simulations show RSA-2048 factoring could need about 48,000 physical qubits and roughly a day under its best assumptions.
- [Quantinuum says Helios hit 99.9995% logical fidelity, a tenfold error-correction record](https://photondispatch.com/news/quantinuum-helios-99-9995-logical-fidelity-color-code.html): Quantinuum says its Helios trapped-ion computer reached 99.9995% logical fidelity with a color code, about five errors per million operations.
- [Google shows magic state cultivation on Willow, cutting errors about 40x](https://photondispatch.com/news/google-magic-state-cultivation-willow-science.html): Google Quantum AI says magic state cultivation worked on its Willow chip, cutting errors about 40-fold and yielding T-states at 99.99% logical fidelity.
- [Qilimanjaro raises €19.6 million Series A first close led by Indra Group](https://photondispatch.com/news/qilimanjaro-19-6m-series-a-first-close-indra-sett.html): Barcelona's Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech says it closed €19.6 million, with €10 million from Indra Group via IndraMind and €9.6 million from Spain's SETT.
- [UK puts £78 million into quantum sensing, networking and apprenticeships](https://photondispatch.com/news/uk-78m-quantum-sensing-networking-quest-apprentices.html): The UK government announced £78 million for quantum: £50 million for sensing and navigation projects, £20 million for networking and £8 million for apprentices.
